basic_details.scholarship_name: Vrije Universiteit Brussel (VUB) Grand Établissement Excellence Scholarship (Belgium)
basic_details.offering_entity: Vrije Universiteit Brussel (Faculty of Sciences and Bioengineering Sciences)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Vrije Universiteit Brussel (VUB) - Brussels Humanities, Sciences & Engineering Campus
basic_details.major_restrictions: MSc Computer Science (Applied Artificial Intelligence, Software Languages & Software Engineering, Data Management & Analytics) and Bioengineering Sciences.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~15 to 25 competitive international excellence scholarships per academic year
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open globally to non-EEA nationals; typically 2 to 4 Pakistani scholars selected in advanced computer science tracks
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 24 months (2-year standard master's programme duration subject to first-year academic progression)

nationality_requirements: Open to all international non-EEA applicants, including citizens of Pakistan
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Preference given to recent graduates within 3 to 5 years of completing undergraduate degree.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 4-year Bachelor of Science (BS / BSc 16-year) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or Informatics with distinguished academic record (minimum CGPA 3.50 / 4.00 or 80%+ equivalent to Belgian Magna Cum Laude distinction).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.50 / 4.00; selected candidates typically maintain CGPA >= 3.70 / 4.00 with top honors in computing courses.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Substantial theoretical and practical foundation in algorithms, software engineering, databases, discrete mathematics, and programming paradigms.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or currently in final semester of undergraduate degree graduating by August 2027.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Relevant research contributions, open-source projects, or software engineering experience highly valued.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificates from recognized Pakistani universities are accepted by VUB Faculty of Sciences; alternatively IELTS Academic 6.5+ or TOEFL iBT 90+.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Dutch/French proficiency is not required; master's programmes are conducted entirely in English.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Open equally to all qualified applicants.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Awarded purely on merit, academic caliber, and research potential.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot simultaneously hold Belgian government VLIR-UOS or Master Mind scholarship.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee waiver for the full 2-year MSc Computer Science program.

admission_application_fee.details: Non-EEA university application screening fee of EUR 84 payable during online application submission.

accommodation.details: Priority access to subsidized VUB on-campus housing at Etterbeek campus (EUR 380 - 480 / month).

monthly_stipend.details: EUR 10,000 per academic year living grant (~EUR 1,000 / month | ~PKR 305,000 / month) disbursed across term periods.

airfare.details: Airfare from Pakistan to Brussels is covered by the student.

visa_fee.details: Belgian long-stay student visa (Type D) administrative fee (~EUR 230) paid to Belgian Immigration Office.

health_insurance.details: Mandatory Belgian Mutuelle health insurance coverage subsidized (~EUR 100/yr).

food_allowance.details: Subsidized meals at VUB student restaurant (Resto) on Etterbeek campus (~EUR 4 to 6 per warm meal).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Course reading materials, electronic databases, and journals provided through VUB Central Library.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Access to state-of-the-art AI lab resources, computing clusters, and high-performance computing (VSC - Flemish Supercomputer Center).

travel_transit_allowance.details: Subsidized Brussels student public transport pass (STIB/MIVB ~EUR 12/year).

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single host university (Vrije Universiteit Brussel - VUB, Brussels, Belgium).
participating_institutions: Vrije Universiteit Brussel (VUB) - Etterbeek Campus, Brussels
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 200 globally in Computer Science (QS World University Rankings by Subject); major European center for Artificial Intelligence.
available_majors: MSc Computer Science (Software Languages & Software Engineering)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering with CGPA 3.50+ / 4.00, detailed course descriptions, MOI certificate or IELTS 6.5+, CV, motivation letter, and EUR 84 application fee.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Single application portal; Artificial Intelligence specialization has higher selectivity.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Detail prior coursework in logic, machine learning, and algorithm design to ensure smooth credit evaluation.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the VUB application portal, select MSc Computer Science, complete personal details, upload certified academic transcripts, syllabus descriptions, and motivation essay, and submit scholarship application section.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Create an applicant profile on VUB Online Application portal and select MSc Computer Science.
Step 2: Upload certified digital copies of Bachelor degree, detailed transcripts, course descriptions, CV, and motivation letter.
Step 3: Tick the scholarship consideration box in the application questionnaire and upload an additional 1-page Scholarship Essay outlining academic achievements.
Step 4: Pay the EUR 84 application fee online before the international deadline (February 15).
Step 5: Applications are assessed by the Faculty Admissions Board and Scholarship Selection Committee.
Step 6: Shortlisted applicants may be invited for an online academic interview with program coordinators.
Step 7: Official scholarship award and admission letters issued by May; accept the offer and initiate Belgian visa procedure.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Routing: Students apply for the MSc program and tick the excellence scholarship consideration checkbox within the single institutional portal.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by two university academic professors via institutional email letters.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Combined motivation and scholarship essay demonstrating why applicant excels in computing and how they plan to leverage VUB's AI and software engineering research.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Overview of previous final year project or proposed thesis area in applied AI, software engineering, or data analytics.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Curriculum vitae detailing programming stacks, open-source projects, and academic honors.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online technical video interview with program professors evaluating computational logic and software concepts.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: MOI certificate accepted, or IELTS Academic 6.5+ / TOEFL iBT 90+.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC degree attestation required for Pakistani applicants.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via VUB application portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: HEC-attested undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related discipline.
Complete semester-wise transcripts showing all subjects, grades, and CGPA.
Brief summaries of computer science courses completed during undergraduate studies.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Official university syllabus booklet or course outline.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Comprehensive CV highlighting coding languages, GitHub portfolio, and academic projects.
2-page personal statement explaining technical ambitions and reasons for scholarship candidacy.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: State personal contribution and future goals.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Letters signed by university professors evaluating intellectual capacity and dedication.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: On official university letterhead with stamps.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official MOI certificate from Pakistani university or IELTS (min 6.5) / TOEFL (min 90).

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Non-EEA applicants requiring visa must submit full application by February 15.

selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 20% (Quality of final year project, coding projects, or published research)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of technical goals and scholarship essay)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 5% (Online academic discussion and clarity of career aspirations)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: VUB Faculty of Sciences Admissions Committee and Computer Science Departmental Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Faculty review committee rates applicants on GPA, curricular prerequisites, motivation, and references.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~600 to 900 international candidates for MSc Computer Science
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~15% for applicants with CGPA >= 3.65 and strong software portfolio
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Top computer science and software engineering graduates with solid project portfolios and strong algorithmic foundations.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from NUST, FAST-NUCES, LUMS, ITU Lahore, and UET Lahore.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, India, Turkey, Egypt, Vietnam, Brazil, Colombia.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of unauthorized intermediaries offering guaranteed Belgian admissions.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Official VUB application fee is exactly EUR 84 payable only via the university's secured payment portal.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: VUB does not collaborate with education consultants for scholarship allocation. Direct submission is strictly mandatory.
hidden_costs_breakdown: First month rental deposit for student accommodation: approx. EUR 750 - 900.
Public transit seasonal pass in Brussels: ~EUR 12/yr subsidized student STIB pass.
Flight from Pakistan to Brussels: ~PKR 170,000 to 240,000.
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You cannot obtain a Belgian student visa without a blocked bank account. Reality: VUB's official scholarship confirmation letter fulfills Belgian Immigration Annex 32 financial requirements completely.
Myth: Knowledge of French or Dutch is mandatory. Reality: Brussels is bilingual but VUB's MSc Computer Science is delivered 100% in English.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Third-party sites frequently claim that IELTS is strictly mandatory; VUB Faculty of Sciences officially accepts MOI certificates from recognized Pakistani universities.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must pass at least 50 ECTS in the first academic year to secure scholarship renewal for year 2.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Mandatory presence for all laboratory practica, seminars, and examination sessions.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: End of semester examination board evaluations (January and June sessions).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Part-time work permitted up to 20 hours per week during academic semesters.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; zero service bond or return obligation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Termination of grant if scholar ceases registration or fails credit progression threshold.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Switching tracks within MSc Computer Science (e.g., AI to Software Engineering) permitted with department director approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Strictly limited to 2 academic years (4 semesters).
